assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.text: Today we're talking about the key to a long and happy life.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.zh: 今天我们要谈谈拥有长久幸福人生的秘诀。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.text: Recent studies of people who live to be a hundred years old have shown that a healthy diet and exercise may not be enough.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.zh: 近期对百岁老人的研究表明，健康饮食和锻炼可能还不够。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.text: In fact many of the people who celebrate their hundreds birthday have not eaten a healthy diet and have never exercised regularly.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.zh: 事实上，许多庆祝百岁生日的人并没有健康饮食，也从未规律锻炼。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.text: This has led many people to believe that our lifestyles are not important.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.zh: 这使许多人相信我们的生活方式并不重要。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.text: What's most important is that we have good genes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.zh: 最重要的是我们拥有好的基因。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.text: It seems that if you have the right genes then you'll live for a long time whatever you do.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_5c84e7c0144acfa.zh: 看来，只要你拥有合适的基因，无论做什么都能活得很久。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c8a3a03b9271cd.text: new research shows that having a healthy lifestyle is not the most important thing if you want to live a long life.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c8a3a03b9271cd.zh: 新研究表明，如果想要长寿，健康的生活方式并不是最重要的因素。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c8a3a03b9271cd.text: We asked four people on the street for their reactions to this news.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7c8a3a03b9271cd.zh: 我们请街头四个人谈谈他们对这则新闻的看法。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f1a799dba7d7c0b.text: Most people think that if they eat healthy food and exercise a lot they'll live forever.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f1a799dba7d7c0b.zh: 大多数人认为，只要吃得健康、经常锻炼，就能永远活下去。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f1a799dba7d7c0b.text: These people never drink coffee or sugary drinks.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f1a799dba7d7c0b.zh: 这些人从不喝咖啡或含糖饮料。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f1a799dba7d7c0b.text: They spend hours working out in the gym or doing yoga and none of this matters if you have the wrong genes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f1a799dba7d7c0b.zh: 他们花好几个小时在健身房锻炼或做瑜伽，可要是基因不好，这一切都没有用。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f1a799dba7d7c0b.text: I think that the key to a healthy life is to enjoy yourself.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f1a799dba7d7c0b.zh: 我认为健康生活的关键是享受生活。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3d69f5e1a72d4ba.text: If you focus all your energy on what to do and what not to do,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3d69f5e1a72d4ba.zh: 如果你把全部精力都放在该做什么、不该做什么上，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3d69f5e1a72d4ba.text: question that happy people live longer.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3d69f5e1a72d4ba.zh: 疑问，快乐的人活得更久。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3d69f5e1a72d4ba.text: I'd much rather go out and have a pizza with friends than spend time in the gym.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3d69f5e1a72d4ba.zh: 我宁愿和朋友出去吃披萨，也不愿花时间待在健身房。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3d69f5e1a72d4ba.text: I'm really happy about this new research.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3d69f5e1a72d4ba.zh: 我对这项新研究感到非常高兴。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.text: This research proves what I've known for a long time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.zh: 这项研究证明了我很早以前就知道的事。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.text: It's ridiculous to get too worried about healthy eating and exercise.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.zh: 过分担心健康饮食和锻炼，实在很可笑。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.text: My grandfather lived until he was 95 even though he never exercised.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.zh: 我的祖父活到95岁，尽管他从不锻炼。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.text: He ate lots of sugar and never ate vegetables.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.zh: 他吃很多糖，从不吃蔬菜。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.text: He was brought up in a different world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.zh: 他是在一个不同的世界里长大的。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.text: He certainly never went to a gym.
Yes, I'm sure that genes are more important than our lifestyle.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7e7f494d5e7ceb2.zh: 是的，我确信基因比我们的生活方式更重要。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2a5ca2ab23a0d0.text: Of course, I'm not going to give up exercising or start eating fast food every day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2a5ca2ab23a0d0.zh: 当然，我不会放弃锻炼，也不会每天开始吃快餐。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2a5ca2ab23a0d0.text: The research shows I should stay in shape because it makes me feel better but I won't allow fitness to take over my whole life.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_e2a5ca2ab23a0d0.zh: 这项研究表明我应该保持健康，因为这让我感觉更好；但我不会让健身占据我的全部生活。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.text: Well, first of all, I prefer to exercise and eat well.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.zh: 嗯，首先，我更喜欢锻炼并且吃得健康。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.text: I also think that you won't know whether or not you have the right genes until you get sick.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.zh: 我还认为，只有生病后你才会知道自己是否拥有合适的基因。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.text: So why take the risk and be unhealthy?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.zh: 那为什么要冒险，让自己不健康呢？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.text: Also, don't forget that you might get the flu or a cold much more easily when you don't eat healthy food or exercise.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.zh: 还有，不要忘记，如果你不健康饮食或不锻炼，就更容易得流感或感冒。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.text: I'd say that it's always better to have a healthy lifestyle.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.zh: 我会说，保持健康的生活方式总是更好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.text: doubt that bad health habits increase the chances of getting a serious illness.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_4f61315c5f4a7fa.zh: 毫无疑问，不良的健康习惯会增加患重病的可能性。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_91becd4dde08b69.text: So now we should all eat fast food and stop exercising?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_91becd4dde08b69.zh: 所以现在我们都该吃快餐、不再锻炼了吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_91becd4dde08b69.text: I mean, I look around and I see overweight children everywhere.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_91becd4dde08b69.zh: 我是说，我环顾四周，到处都能看到超重的孩子。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_91becd4dde08b69.text: matter how good their genes are, I'm sure that these children won't be able to enjoy a long and healthy life unless they give up crisps,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_91becd4dde08b69.zh: 不管他们的基因多好，我相信这些孩子若不戒掉薯片，便无法享有长久健康的人生，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b2c8e33ad72515.text: Well it's great that some people can live to be a hundred and do whatever they want in their lives but I prefer to be careful and take care of myself because I don't know if I have good genes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_8b2c8e33ad72515.zh: 有些人能活到一百岁，想怎么生活就怎么生活，这当然很好；但我更愿意谨慎些、照顾好自己，因为我不知道自己的基因是否好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: Do you have problems focusing on your work?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 你在专注于工作时有困难吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: Are you under a lot of stress?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 你压力很大吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: Do you want to get more exercise while trying something new and exciting?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 你想在尝试新鲜刺激事物的同时多锻炼吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: If so, it's time to take up taekwondo.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 如果是这样，该开始练跆拳道了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: Taekwondo is great exercise and as we all know exercise is good for your health.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 跆拳道是很好的锻炼，而且众所周知，锻炼有益健康。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: Taekwondo also has mental benefits.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 跆拳道还有心理方面的益处。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: It has been shown to improve your concentration.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 事实证明，它能提高你的专注力。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: In addition,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 此外，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: it makes you feel good about yourself.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 此外，它会让你自我感觉良好。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: This martial art was developed in Korea and is now popular around the world.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 这项武术起源于韩国，现在在世界各地都很受欢迎。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: Whether you are looking for physical well -being,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 无论你是在追求身体健康，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: increased confidence or a life with less stress,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 增强自信，还是想过压力更小的生活，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.text: Black Belt Taekwondo has it all.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 黑带跆拳道都能满足你。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_d72ef4cb74a19ad.zh: 科学研究已经证明，团队运动能带来所有这些好处。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: Hi,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 你好，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: my name's Angie Stratton and I'm the director of Culture Cycle.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 我叫安吉·斯特拉顿，是“文化骑行”的负责人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: Culture Cycle is a new concept in travel,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: “文化骑行”是一种新的旅行理念，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: educational fitness touring.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 教育健身旅行。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: We offer courses all over the world which combine learning with exercise and travel.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 我们在世界各地提供把学习、锻炼和旅行结合起来的课程。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: Each course has an educational theme such as Brazilian cooking or the history of Turkey.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 每门课程都有一个教育主题，例如巴西烹饪或土耳其历史。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: As a small group,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 我们组成小团体，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: we cycle from place to place,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 骑自行车从一个地方到另一个地方，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: stopping for several days in each location to rest,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 在每个地点停留几天休息，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: relax and do some hands -on learning.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 放松并开展一些实践学习。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: Not only does this trip provide terrific exercise and a fascinating cultural experience,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 这趟旅行不仅能提供很好的锻炼和引人入胜的文化体验，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: it's the best way to learn.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 还是最好的学习方式。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.zh: 毫无

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: question that physical activity improves our memory and thinking skills.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: So, after a few days of cycling,

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_ac74330a84f013e.text: So, be kind to your body and your mind and come with us on an amazing adventure you'll never forget.
